in_marathi.name: Vishwjeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishwjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vishwjeet is composed of two parts. The first part, Vishw, means universe or cosmos. The second part, jeet, means conqueror. Thus, Vishwjeet means universal conqueror or one who conquers the universe.
